lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The coastal town of Vellmouth wakes to fog and gulls.

lines.speaker: Yu
lines.text: Another year at the harbour school. Maybe this time will be different.

lines.speaker: Alice
lines.text: Hey, you're the new transfer, right? I'm Alice. Want to see the lighthouse with me?

lines.speaker: Bob
lines.text: Don't forget the assignment due tomorrow. I'll be at the library, if you need help.

lines.speaker: Carol
lines.text: Two paths, one dawn. Choose carefully, kid.
